form.label: CCDC | Palo Alto
form.description: PAN-OS 11.0.2 management 172.20.240.200. Requires configured syslog and a suitable sourcetype. Firewall syslog is not automatically forwarded by endpoint UFs.

search.query: index=* (sourcetype=pan* OR sourcetype=ccdc:pan_syslog) | stats count by host,sourcetype | sort -count
index=* (sourcetype=pan:traffic OR sourcetype=pan:firewall OR sourcetype=ccdc:pan_syslog) | stats count by action,src,dst | sort -count
index=* (sourcetype=pan:threat OR sourcetype=pan:firewall OR sourcetype=ccdc:pan_syslog) ("THREAT" OR type=THREAT) | table _time host src dst action severity threatid _raw | sort -_time
index=* (sourcetype=pan:config OR sourcetype=pan:system OR sourcetype=ccdc:pan_syslog) | table _time host sourcetype _raw | sort -_time
